tagline: Diversified provider of banking, factoring, payments and intelligence services for the trucking industry
hero_kpi_rationale: Consolidated total assets of $6.381 billion reflect the scale and operational scope of the group, including factoring, payments, and traditional banking services segments.

kpis.name: Interest and factoring revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by specialized factoring services for the trucking industry covering hauls exceeding 400 kilometers.
kpis.description: Factoring revenue stems from providing working capital to specialized trucking operators through discounted invoice purchases.

kpis.name: Net interest revenue
kpis.explanation: Net interest revenue generated by traditional banking services, equipment loans, and mortgage financing.
kpis.description: Net interest revenue represents the stable earnings source from traditional banking operations and specialized lending products.

kpis.name: Consolidated total assets
kpis.explanation: Total consolidated assets including loans, investment securities, and TBK Bank assets.
kpis.description: Consolidated total assets of $6.381 billion as of December 31, 2025 reflect organic growth and strategic acquisitions.

kpis.short: Prêts détenus à des fins d'investissement
kpis.name: Held-for-investment loan portfolio
kpis.explanation: Total held-for-investment loan portfolio, net of allowance for credit losses.
kpis.description: Held-for-investment loans represent the core of interest-earning assets, including specialized commercial loans and factoring.

kpis.name: Total deposits
kpis.description: Total deposits include non-interest-bearing deposits ($1,902M) and interest-bearing deposits ($3,049M) as of December 31, 2025.

kpis.name: Consolidated net income
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net income after income tax provision.
kpis.description: Consolidated net income of $25.4 million in 2025 reflects 57.5% growth versus 2024 ($16.1M).

kpis.name: Non-interest revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by payment services, data intelligence, and other non-interest services.
kpis.description: Non-interest revenue of $88.4 million in 2025 represents a 35.2% increase versus 2024 ($65.4M), driven by payments services growth and Intelligence expansion.

kpis.name: Total shareholders' equity
kpis.explanation: Total shareholders' equity including common stock and preferred stock.
kpis.description: Total shareholders' equity of $941.8 million as of December 31, 2025 reflects a 5.7% increase versus 2024.

kpis.name: Intelligence service launch
kpis.explanation: Intelligence service launched in early Q4 2024 to transform trucking transportation data into actionable insights.
kpis.description: Intelligence service launch in Q4 2024 represents a new business line based on data collected through factoring and payments services.

kpis.name: Isometric Technologies Inc. acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Isometric Technologies Inc., a provider of service and performance scoring capabilities for the trucking industry.
kpis.description: Isometric Technologies Inc. acquisition in Q4 2024 strengthened Intelligence and benchmarking capabilities across the group.

kpis.name: Greenscreens AI Inc. acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Greenscreens AI Inc., an AI-powered pricing solution with short-term freight market intelligence for the logistics industry.
kpis.description: Greenscreens AI Inc. acquisition in Q2 2025 enriched Intelligence capabilities with an AI-driven freight pricing solution.

kpis.short: Lancement du produit Factoring as a Service
kpis.name: Factoring as a Service (FaaS) product launch
kpis.explanation: Launch in 2024 of FaaS product offering factoring back-office services to trucking sector clients.
kpis.description: FaaS enables factoring clients to complement internal operations or offer fully platform-supported factoring services via TFIN infrastructure.

risks.title: Credit risk related to Tricolor deposit
risks.score_rationale: Risk is documented in the context of bankruptcy proceedings for alleged fraud by a major borrower (Tricolor), with exposure of $22.5 million. Language indicates risk of material losses if first-lien security position is contested. Risk is new and tied to a concrete event, increasing immediate intensity. Credit category is heavily weighted in banking context.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and digital attacks
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 1A and integrated within enterprise risk management framework. CISO reports quarterly to the board, indicating elevated oversight. Language is recurring and structured, though without mention of recent incidents. Cybersecurity category is critical for a financial services and IT company.

risks.title: Banking regulation and restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Document mentions federal and state regulatory restrictions on dividends, acquisition approvals, and capital policies. Language is precise and repeated, notably regarding limitations imposed by Texas banking authorities and federal supervisory agencies. Regulation category is highly weighted for a regulated financial institution.

risks.title: Dependence on specific sector
risks.score_rationale: Risk is documented in MD&A with revenue concentration in trucking sector. Language is moderate but recurring. Risk is stable but structural. Competition category includes sectoral dependence as it directly affects revenue diversification.

risks.title: Acquisition integration
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned in MD&A concerning potential integration difficulties from past and future acquisitions (HubTran, Isometric Technologies, Greenscreens AI). Language indicates imprecision regarding future performance and integration risks. Risk is stable but recurring. Technology category is appropriate as acquisitions involve software platforms and AI solutions critical to operations.

risks.title: Litigation and legal proceedings
risks.score_rationale: Document mentions routine litigation but identifies Tricolor as representing potentially material risk. Language is measured on other litigation but precise on Tricolor financial implications. Risk is stable overall but Tricolor case renders it more salient. Litigation category is weighted moderately.

ai_positioning.summary: Triumph Financial integrates artificial intelligence across factoring and payments operations. The company acquired Greenscreens AI Inc. for AI-powered pricing capabilities and leverages technology to enhance automation, fraud detection, and operational efficiency within its specialized trucking transportation network.
evidence: Isometric Technologies Inc. acquisition for service and performance scoring (Q4 2024)
AI deployment across factoring, payments, and Intelligence segments
Intelligence service launch based on collected transportation data
